CNT-based devices can provide ultrafast pulse generation, tunability of pulse repetition rate, and wavelength tunability of mode-locking.

CNT saturable absorbers can be used for passively mode-locking fiber lasers, which can be operated in the picosecond, femtosecond and nanosecond regimes.
